metadata.title: Hyderabad Published Flood-Prone Vulnerability Zones
metadata.description: Geographical boundaries of published flood-prone sectors, Musi River causeways, and urban nala inundation corridors compiled from GHMC Disaster Management and MRDCL surveys.
metadata.publisher: GHMC Disaster Management Cell & Musi Riverfront Development Corporation Ltd (MRDCL)
metadata.verification_notice: Historical inundation and flood vulnerability boundaries compiled from published municipal and academic surveys. Real-time water depth and gate discharge must be verified with official emergency authorities. These static zones do not constitute a live sensor feed.

properties.title: Musi River Central Causeway Inundation Corridor
properties.description: Critical low-level causeway inundation zone spanning Chaderghat bridge to Moosarambagh causeway. Subject to rapid flash submergence during upstream reservoir releases from Osman Sagar and Himayat Sagar.
properties.source_name: GHMC Disaster Management & MRDCL Published Hydrology Survey
properties.verification_note: Historical river flood zone. Floods when Musi river discharge exceeds 12,000 cusecs.

properties.title: Moosa Nagar - Shankarnagar Low-Lying Riverbed Settlement Zone
properties.description: High-vulnerability riverbed settlement zone on the northern bank of the Musi River. Experiences severe backwater stagnation and direct inundation during monsoon peak flows.
properties.source_name: MRDCL Field Survey & TISS Flood Vulnerability Assessment
properties.verification_note: High vulnerability settlement sector within 50m of river channel boundary.

properties.title: Bapu Ghat - Langar House Confluence Inundation Zone
properties.description: Hydraulic confluence sector where the Esa River merges with the Musa River. Subject to backwater spreading into Langar House and Hyderguda low pockets during high runoff.
properties.source_name: GHMC Stormwater Master Plan & TRAC Basin Studies
properties.verification_note: Confluence floodplain zone; vulnerable to backwater inundation.

properties.title: Hussain Sagar Surplus Nala Inundation Corridor
properties.description: Major storm-water discharge corridor carrying surplus overflow from Hussain Sagar through Ashok Nagar and Himayatnagar towards Musi River. Prone to localized water-logging during downpours >50mm/hr.
properties.verification_note: Surplus discharge channel buffer; localized street inundation hotspot.

properties.title: Begumpet - Brahmanwadi Stormwater Drainage Bottleneck
properties.description: Constrained storm-water bottleneck where multiple northern drainage tributaries converge near the railway underbridge and Prakash Nagar nala. Frequent road submergence during intense localized showers.
properties.source_name: GHMC Disaster Management Cell Inundation Points Inventory
properties.verification_note: Known severe water stagnation point; railway underpass flood hazard.
